segments.ja380:2.1: Taṃ devā payirupāsanti, tāva dūraphalaṃ satiṃ;
segments.ja380:2.3: Āsīseva [āsiṃseva (sī. syā. pī.)] tuvaṃ rāja, āsā phalavatī sukhā.
segments.ja380:3.1: Āsīsateva [āsiṃsetheva (sī. syā. pī.)] so pakkhī, āsīsateva [āsiṃsetheva (sī. syā. pī.)] so dijo;
segments.ja380:3.3: Tassa cāsā [tassevāsā (syā.)] samijjhati, tāva dūragatā satī;
segments.ja380:3.5: Āsīseva tuvaṃ rāja, āsā phalavatī sukhā.
segments.ja380:4.1: Sampesi kho maṃ vācāya, na ca sampesi [saṃsesi (ka.)] kammunā;
segments.ja380:5.1: Aphalaṃ madhuraṃ vācaṃ, yo mittesu pakubbati;
segments.ja380:5.3: Adadaṃ avissajaṃ bhogaṃ, sandhi tenassa jīrati.
segments.ja380:6.1: Yañhi kayirā tañhi vade, yaṃ na kayirā na taṃ vade;
segments.ja380:7.1: Balañca vata me khīṇaṃ, pātheyyañca na vijjati;
segments.ja380:8.1: Etadeva hi me nāmaṃ, yaṃ nāmasmi rathesabha;
